$comment: ExampleEmbed is deliberately absent from `types` below (7 entries, not 8). Per design doc claude-notes/designs/pandoc-hybrid-architecture.md §3: 'ExampleEmbed is a real wire-format CustomNode, but never reaches this shim for Pandoc targets ... It is not a Route N case in practice — there is no CustomNode("ExampleEmbed") left for the shim to route by the time a Pandoc render reaches this bridge.' The `example-embed-render` transform (crates/quarto-core/src/transforms/example_embed.rs:274) resolves ExampleEmbed entirely in Rust upstream of the wire-format cut, so no CustomNode("ExampleEmbed") ever survives to be assigned a route. Every route value (L, R, or N) would misrepresent this, so the type is omitted rather than shoehorned in.
